evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Matched grammatical frame ('a rollback we… is a rollback we…') sets rehearsed vs. not-rehearsed as deliberate opposed clauses — parallelism doing antithesis work.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: a thing we have not rehearsed is a thing we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the rule here crystallized into matched opposed clauses that make the contrast feel self-evident?
